text:
Priya: Heads up — I'm prototyping a compact 'evidence mapping' worksheet for self-reviews. Goal: make it trivial for ICs to attach 1–3 concrete artifacts per KR and write a single-sentence impact line. Draft link: https://rwd.in/evidence-draft (feel free to copy).

Alex: Nice. Quick ask — can we include a small 'metric before/after' field? For product KRs that helps tie evidence to outcome.

Priya: Good call — added a column. Draft structure (super compact):
```
KR | Supporting artifact (link) | Metric before -> after | 1-line impact statement
---|---------------------------|------------------------|------------------------
Increase search click-through | /drive/search-test-report.pdf | CTR 12% -> 18% | Reduced time-to-result; users find answers faster, driving engagement
```

Sam: Love the sample. Can we add a short prompt bank for writing the "impact statement"? A lot of folks freeze on wording.

Priya: Yep. Pasting 3 micro-templates for impact statements (pick and tweak):
- "Enabled X by doing Y, which resulted in Z."
- "Reduced [time/cost/error] by N%, improving [metric]."
- "Removed blocker Y so team Z shipped feature X faster, increasing adoption."

Jordan: These are super actionable — I'll push to managers to use in 1:1s. Small nit: rename "Supporting artifact" -> "Evidence (link)" to avoid confusion. Also add an optional "Reviewer notes" column for managers to paste short calibration comments.

Priya: Updated again — renamed and added reviewer notes. Also added two UX examples for non-metric work.
```
KR | Evidence (link) | Before -> After | Impact statement | Reviewer notes
---|------------------|-----------------|------------------|----------------
Mentorship program pilot | /drive/mentorship/summary.md | N/A -> 6 mentees matched | Built early-career retention by creating structured mentorship pairing | Manager: strong coaching examples
```

Sam: Perfect. Can we include 1-sentence guidance at top: "For each KR, drop 1 short link and a 1-line impact—no more than 25 words"? Keeps self-reviews scannable.

Priya: Done. Draft doc now has: short guidance, the worksheet table, and the micro-templates section for impact phrasing. Planning to post in "#people-ops" and /share in the self-review kickoff doc tomorrow. Any final edits? :raised_hands:

People Ops Bot: Reminder: Self-review window opens 2024-06-15. Auto-checklist will appear in the People Ops portal on that date.

Alex: Looks good to me. Thanks Priya — this will save managers a ton of follow-up.

Priya: Thanks all — merging into the kickoff pack and scheduling a short demo for managers next Wed at 11am.
